errors.text_span: "Interview (2/38)" in dark navy (about 5%), "Organizational Report (2/38)" in muted purple (about 5%)
errors.evidence: According to the image and reference description, Interview is shown in blue/navy and Organizational Report is in purple/pink. The machine-generated description has these colors swapped — it assigns dark navy to Interview and muted purple to Organizational Report, when the image shows Interview in dark navy/blue and Organizational Report in a pinkish-purple/lavender color. This matches the reference which says Interview is purple and Organizational Report is blue, but the image shows the opposite mapping from what the reference states. Looking at the image carefully, Interview appears in dark navy/blue and Organizational Report in pink/purple — so the machine description has the color assignments correct for the image but the reference says Interview=purple and Organizational Report=blue. The machine-generated description correctly maps colors to the image, so this may not be an error relative to the image.

The reference description mentions 'The chart includes labels both inside and outside the slices, indicating the proportion of each category as well as a legend.' The machine-generated description explicitly states there is no separate legend, but the reference indicates one is present.

The reference notes that slices are ordered by size, with the largest starting from the left side proceeding clockwise. The machine-generated description does not explicitly mention this clockwise ordering by size.

The reference description states Organizational Report is in blue and Interview is in purple. The image shows Interview as the darker blue segment and Organizational Report as the lighter pink/purple segment. The machine description assigns 'muted purple' to Organizational Report which appears closer to pink/lavender in the image, while calling Interview 'dark navy' — the color descriptions are approximately correct per the image, though the reference swaps these assignments.
